Ar roots should be interpreted as extensions in a R₃ from the above nuclei. (Ehret1989) From * ¹ʕR‑ ‘to take out, remove’ (with some values given in French as in BK1860 where they differ from Ehret’s rendering, 1 or are more detailed): (reduplicated simple form > intensive): ʕarʕar ‘to uncork, pull out an eye’ ↗ † ʕRʕR_1 † ʕarʕara ‘remuer (le bouchon d’une bouteille, pour la déboucher); ôter, enlever le bouchon; tirer, arracher, crever (l’œil)’ in extendative * ‑b : ʕarab ‘to separate, put by, put aside’ [?] in diffusive * ‑ṯ : ʕarṯ ‘to remove, lift up, lay aside’ ↗ † ʕRṮ_1 † ʕaraṯa ( u , ʕarṯ ) ‘écarter, éloigner, ôter de sa place’ in durative * ‑d : ʕard ‘ to throw or fling far’ ↗ † ʕRD_2 † ʕarada ( u , ʕurūd ) ‘lancer une pierre au loin ’; ʕarad ‘to flee, take to flight’ ↗ † ʕRD_3 † ʕarida ( a , ?) ‘fuir, s’enfuir’ in durative * ‑d + fortative * ‑s : ʕardas ‘to throw to the ground’ ↗ † ʕRDS_1 † ʕardasa ‘renverser, jeter à terre’ in intensive (manner) * ‑z : ʕarz ‘to tear out violently’ ↗ † ʕRZ_1 † ʕaraza ( i , ?) ‘tirer avec force’ in middle * ‑ḍ : ʕarḍ ‘to offer, present, show itself, happen, occur, come to meet, show, bring to mind, give or take in exchange’ ↗ ʕaraḍa ( i , ʕarḍ ) in andative * ‑ḳ : ʕarq ‘to depart, set out’, ? cf. ↗ † ʕRQ_7 † ʕaraqa ( i , ʕarq , ʕurūq ) fī ’l-ʔarḍ ‘to penetrate into a country’ in inchoative * ‑w (‘to be brought forth’): ʕarw ‘to come up to, approach, visit, occur, happen’ ↗ † ʕRW_1 † ʕarā ( u , ʕarw ) In Ehret1995, the author postulated yet three other *ʕR‑ nuclei: (#695) 2-cons. nucleus * ²ʕR‑ ‘to be raised’. Extensions: in extendative * ‑b : ʕarb ‘to swell and suppurate’ ↗ † ʕRB_16 in finitive fortative * ‑g : ʕarǧ ‘to mount’ ↗ ʕaraǧa ( u , ʕurūǧ ) ‘to ascent, mount, rise’ in durative * ‑d : ʕard ‘to shoot up, grow’ ↗ ʕarada ( u , ʕurūd ) ‘to grow (tooth, plant)’ in venitive * ‑ɬ : ʕarš ‘to build’ ↗ ʕaraša ( i , u ) ‘to erect a trellis’ (#696) 2-cons. nucleus * ³ʕR‑ ‘to burn (intr.), shine’. Extensions: in durative * ‑t : ʕart ‘to lighten, flash, shine’ ↗ † ʕRT_2 † ʕarata ( i , u ) ‘trembler et briller’ in venitive * ‑ɬ : ʕarš ‘to be kindled and kept burning’ ↗ † ʕRŠ_2 † ʕuriša (vb.pass.) ‘continuer à brûler lentement et former comme un bûcher (se dit de tout ce qui alimente le feu, al-waqūd )’ in focative * ‑tl’ : ʕarṣ ‘to lighten continually’ ↗ † ʕRṢ_2 † ʕariṣa ( i , ʕaraṣ ) ‘briller avec un mouvement tremblant (se dit des éclairs)’; ? cf. also ↗ ʕariṣa ( a , ʕaraṣ ) ‘to be lively, gay, merry’ (#697) 2-cons. nucleus * ⁴ʕR‑ ‘hard, firm, strong’. Extensions: in adj.suff * ‑t (with vb. ʕart ‘to be hard’ ↗ † ʕRT_1 † ʕarata ( i , u ) in durative * ‑d + adj.suff. * ‑l : ʕard ↗ † ʕRD_2 † ʕarid ‘dur, roide’ ; † ʕardal ‘hard, firm, stiff’ [?] in intensive (manner) * ‑ z : ʕarz ‘to be thick and strong, hard and contracted’ ↗ † ʕRZ_2 † ʕariza ( a , ?) ‘être contracté, se contracter’ 1 .
